The [draft schedule](schedule.qmd) uses the Spring 2026 pacing to propose Test 1 on February 25 and Test 2 on April 6. Both dates are tentative. The final-examination slot, grading weights, allowed materials, and coverage remain pending instructor review.

## Carried-Forward Test Instructions

The Spring 2026 instructions below are retained for revision and are not yet Spring 2027 policy:

- Tests were closed book, with a limited number of letter-sized note sheets.
- Calculators, phones, and other electronic devices were not allowed.
- Required critical values were provided.
- Students showed their work and signed an integrity statement.

{{< include ../classlib/classlib/quarto/snippets/search-test-archives.qmd >}}

## Released MATH 563 Archive

```{python}
#| echo: false
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

root = Path("../assets/tests/archive/563")
pdfs = sorted(root.glob("*.pdf"), key=lambda p: p.name.lower()) if root.exists() else []
if not pdfs:
    display(Markdown("*No archived MATH 563 tests found.*"))
else:
    display(Markdown("\n".join(
        f"- [{p.stem.replace('_', ' ')}](../assets/tests/archive/563/{quote(p.name)})"
        for p in pdfs
    )))
```
